2-s17.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 9, упр. 2, с. 17. Послушай запись и скажи, что у мамы есть на столе.
steps: She has got some coffee, some soup, some porridge, some ham, a sandwich, a banana and an orange.
2-s17.answer: Coffee, soup, porridge, ham, a sandwich, a banana and an orange.

3-s17.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 9, упр. 3, с. 17. Прочитай диалог и отгадай, что сказала мама в конце разговора.
steps: Mother: Help yourself! — Угощайся!

4-s18.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 9, упр. 4, с. 18. Прочитай диалог по ролям.
steps: Mother: Good morning, Billy! — Billy: Good morning, Mum! I'm hungry. — Would you like some porridge? — Sorry, I don't like porridge. I'd like some corn flakes. — OK. Would you like some milk? — Yes, please. — Help yourself!
4-s18.answer: — Good morning, Billy! — Good morning, Mum! I'm hungry. — Would you like some porridge? — Sorry, I don't like porridge. I'd like some corn flakes. — Would you like some milk? — Yes, please. — Help yourself!

5-s18.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 9, упр. 5, с. 18. Скажи, что ты любишь есть на завтрак.
steps: Пример: I like tea and sandwiches for breakfast.
5-s18.answer: I like tea and sandwiches for breakfast.

6-s18.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 9, упр. 6, с. 18. a) Заполни анкету о том, что любит твой друг. b) Узнай у друга, правильно ли ты ответил(-а).
steps: a) Отмечаем в таблице yes/no: soup, tea, porridge, coffee, meat, tomatoes, sandwiches.
b) Do you like soup? Do you like tea? Do you like porridge? Do you like coffee? Do you like meat? Do you like tomatoes? Do you like sandwiches?
6-s18.answer: b) Do you like soup / tea / porridge / coffee / meat / tomatoes / sandwiches?

7-s18.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 9, упр. 7, с. 18. a) Послушай и прочитай вопросительные слова. b) Составь с ними вопросы и ответы.
steps: a) why — почему, what — что, where — где, when — когда, who — кто.

b) Why don't you like meat? — Because I like vegetables. What do you like for lunch? — I like sandwiches. Where do you have breakfast? — In the kitchen. When do you have dinner? — At 6 o'clock. Who is your favourite fairy tale character? — The Little Mermaid.
7-s18.answer: why, what, where, when, who. Why don't you like meat? What do you like for lunch? Where do you have breakfast? When do you have dinner? Who is your favourite character?

homework-s18.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 9, домашнее задание, с. 18. Составь меню на завтрак, обед и ужин.
steps: Breakfast — an egg, a sandwich and coffee. Lunch — soup, cake and tea. Dinner — fish, potatoes and tea.
homework-s18.answer: Breakfast: an egg, a sandwich, coffee. Lunch: soup, cake, tea. Dinner: fish, potatoes, tea.

1-s19.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 10, упр. 1, с. 19. Послушай запись и скажи, какие два друга пришли в гости к Питеру.
steps: Один гость не любит суп, но любит морковку — кролик; другой любит мёд и сладости, но не кашу — медвежонок.

2-s19.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 10, упр. 2, с. 19. В парах разыграйте диалог за столом, выбрав двух персонажей с картинок.
steps: Cat: Would you like some porridge? — Mouse: No, thank you. I don't like porridge. — Would you like some carrots? — I'm sorry, I don't like carrots. — Would you like some cheese? — Yes, please. I like cheese! — Help yourself! — Thank you!
2-s19.answer: — Would you like some porridge? — No, thank you. — Would you like some cheese? — Yes, please! — Help yourself! — Thank you!

3-s19.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 10, упр. 3, с. 19. Послушай запись и правильно прочитай слова.
steps: bird — птица, girl — девочка, dirty — грязный, her — её, shirt — рубашка, farmer — фермер, tiger — тигр, butter — масло, doctor — врач.
3-s19.answer: bird, girl, dirty, her, shirt, farmer, tiger, butter, doctor.

4-s19.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 10, упр. 4, с. 19. Раздели слова на две группы: со звуком /ɜː/ и со звуком /ə/.
steps: /ɜː/ (ударный): girl, bird, her, shirt, dirty. /ə/ (безударный -er): farmer, butter, tiger, doctor.
4-s19.answer: /ɜː/: girl, bird, her, shirt, dirty; /ə/: farmer, butter, tiger, doctor.

5-s20.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 10, упр. 5, с. 20. Вспомни, как образуется специальный вопрос, соотнеси вопросы 1–4 с ответами A–D и догадайся, кто отвечал.
steps: 1 — C, 2 — D, 3 — A, 4 — B. Отвечал кролик Мартин.

6-s20.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 10, упр. 6, с. 20. Задай три специальных вопроса одному из учеников лесной школы.
steps: Where do you live? When do you have breakfast? Why do you like honey?
6-s20.answer: Where do you live? When do you have breakfast? Why do you like honey?

homework-s20.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 10, домашнее задание, с. 20. Придумай пять вопросов и задай их одному из учеников школы.
steps: Where do you live? When do you get up? When do you have breakfast? Why do you like carrots? Why do you like the pig?
homework-s20.answer: Where do you live? When do you get up? When do you have breakfast? Why do you like carrots? Why do you like Peter?

1-s20.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 11, упр. 1, с. 20. Послушай рассказ и скажи, что хотели бы попробовать Джим и Джилл в столовой лесной школы.
steps: Jim would like some soup, a ham sandwich and some tea. Jill would like some porridge, a cheese sandwich and some orange juice.
1-s20.answer: Jim — soup, a ham sandwich and tea; Jill — porridge, a cheese sandwich and orange juice.

2-s20.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 11, упр. 2, с. 20. Скажи, что тебе хотелось бы попробовать.
steps: Пример: I would like some cake, apples, soup and juice.
2-s20.answer: I would like some cake, apples, soup and juice.
